description:
## Changes
- Add YouTube 21.20.405 compatibility while retaining the 21.04.223 target.
- Fix playback-rate fingerprint matching after official Morphe custom playback speeds changes the speed limits. The Niconico bundle observes playback speed; it does not change the limits.
- Update English, Korean and Japanese installation/update instructions.

## Validation
- Reproduced the 1.3.1 fingerprint failure on the original YouTube 21.20.405 APK.
- Applied Morphe Patches 1.47.0 and this bundle together: 97 patches succeeded and APK rebuilding completed.
- Five fingerprint regression tests passed, including original and Morphe-modified speed limits.
- Device playback and the older APK were not retested for this release.

## Update
In Morphe, open Sources, select Niconico YT Comments Patches and tap Update. Confirm bundle version 1.3.2, then patch the unmodified YouTube APK again.

Remote source: https://github.com/david419kr/niconico-yt-morphe-patches

For a local source, download patches-1.3.2.mpp and replace the previous local source.
